Here’s an advanced Keras project—taking you leaps beyond typical examples:

Project Title

ai-ml-ds-NZqXjLr8Wm – Multimodal Transformer-based Text-to-Image Generator

File: multimodal_transformer_text_to_image.py

🧠 Short Description

Build a compact-but-powerful text-to-image generator by combining a custom lightweight Transformer (for text) and a small image decoder (via convolutional layers + pixel-level upsampling). The model learns joint multimodal representations—text embeddings guide image generation directly, using Keras.

⚙️ Python Code

This script is the vast majority of the answer (code-first, minimal prose):

# multimodal_transformer_text_to_image.py

import tensorflow as tf
from tensorflow import keras
from tensorflow.keras import layers
import numpy as np
import tensorflow_datasets as tfds

# Constants
batch_size: int = 64
max_text_len: int = 20
vocab_size: int = 5000
d_model: int = 128
num_heads: int = 4
ff_dim: int = 512
image_size: int = 32
channels: int = 3
epochs: int = 50

# Load CUB birds dataset for paired text captions + images
(ds_train, ds_val), ds_info = tfds.load(
    "caltech_birds2011_cropped",
    split=["train", "test"],
    with_info=True,
    shuffle_files=True,
)

# Preprocess text + images
tokenizer = keras.preprocessing.text.Tokenizer(num_words=vocab_size, oov_token="<unk>")
texts = []
for ex in tfds.as_numpy(ds_train.take(20000)):
    texts.append(ex["image/filename"].decode("utf-8").split("/")[0])  # dummy caption = class name
tokenizer.fit_on_texts(texts)

def preprocess(ex):
    img: tf.Tensor = tf.image.resize(ex["image"], (image_size, image_size))
    img = tf.cast(img, tf.float32) / 127.5 - 1.0
    txt_seq = tokenizer.texts_to_sequences([ex["image/filename"].numpy().decode().split("/")[0]])[0]
    txt_seq = txt_seq[:max_text_len] + [0] * max(0, max_text_len - len(txt_seq))
    return {"text": tf.constant(txt_seq, dtype=tf.int32), "image": img}

ds_train_proc = ds_train.map(lambda x: tf.py_function(preprocess, [x], [tf.int32, tf.float32]),
                             num_parallel_calls=tf.data.AUTOTUNE).map(
    lambda t, i: {"text": t, "image": i}
).shuffle(10000).batch(batch_size).prefetch(tf.data.AUTOTUNE)

# Transformer Encoder for text
def get_text_encoder() -> keras.Model:
    text_input = layers.Input(shape=(max_text_len,), dtype=tf.int32)
    x = layers.Embedding(vocab_size, d_model)(text_input)
    attn_out = layers.MultiHeadAttention(num_heads=num_heads, key_dim=d_model)(x, x)
    x = layers.Add()([x, attn_out])
    x = layers.LayerNormalization()(x)
    ffn = keras.Sequential([
        layers.Dense(ff_dim, activation="relu"),
        layers.Dense(d_model),
    ])
    x_ff = ffn(x)
    x = layers.Add()([x, x_ff])
    x = layers.LayerNormalization()(x)
    # Pooling to get fixed vector
    x = layers.GlobalAveragePooling1D()(x)
    return keras.Model(text_input, x, name="text_encoder")

# Image decoder
def get_image_decoder() -> keras.Model:
    latent_input = layers.Input(shape=(d_model,))
    x = layers.Dense(8 * 8 * d_model, activation="relu")(latent_input)
    x = layers.Reshape((8, 8, d_model))(x)
    x = layers.Conv2DTranspose(128, 4, strides=2, padding="same", activation="relu")(x)
    x = layers.Conv2DTranspose(64, 4, strides=2, padding="same", activation="relu")(x)
    x = layers.Conv2D(32, 3, padding="same", activation="relu")(x)
    x = layers.Conv2D(channels, 3, padding="same", activation="tanh")(x)
    return keras.Model(latent_input, x, name="image_decoder")

# Full model
text_enc = get_text_encoder()
img_dec = get_image_decoder()
txt_in = layers.Input(shape=(max_text_len,), dtype=tf.int32, name="text")
lat = text_enc(txt_in)
img_out = img_dec(lat)
model = keras.Model(txt_in, img_out)
model.compile(optimizer="adam", loss="mse")

# Training
model.fit(ds_train_proc, epochs=epochs, validation_data=None)

# Sampling
def gen_image(caption: str):
    seq = tokenizer.texts_to_sequences([caption])[:max_text_len]
    seq = seq + [0] * (max_text_len - len(seq))
    seq_arr = np.array([seq], dtype=np.int32)
    img: np.ndarray = model.predict(seq_arr)[0]
    img_vis = ((img + 1) * 127.5).astype(np.uint8)
    tf.keras.preprocessing.image.save_img("out.png", img_vis)

# Test usage
if __name__ == "__main__":
    gen_image("sparrow")

🔍 Example Use Case & Expected Output

Use case: gen_image("blue jay")
Expected: Generates and saves out.png showing a simplified bird image matching the caption.

🚀 Key Learnings

  • Features: Multimodal embedding, Transformer encoder, Conv decoder
  • Components: Embedding, MHA, positional pooling, conv–transpose
  • Keywords: text-to-image, multimodal transformers, decoder, convolutional upsampling
  • Categories: Generative modeling, multimodal learning
  • Hashtags: #TextToImage #Transformer #MultimodalAI
  • Research: DALLE-mini, VQGAN, CLIP, latent diffusion, transformer decoders

📦 Project Summary

  • Problem Domain: Multimodal (text + image) synthesis
  • Use Cases: Generating quick concept sketches; augmenting datasets; UI prototyping
  • Frameworks: TensorFlow, Keras, tfds
  • Lifecycle: Requirements → dataset streaming → model dev/training → quality evaluation → tuning → deployment → monitoring
  • Sister Projects: CLIP-guided image refinement; VQGAN autoencoder; diffusion-text models
  • Integrations: Web UI, REST API, JS frontend, dataset augmentation pipelines
  • Timestamp: July 1, 2025
  • Timeframe: ~6–8 weeks (prototype → deployment)
  • Final Product: A CLI / mini API returning generated images from textual prompts
  • Pro-level Bonus: Add latent VQ-VAE encoder + adversarial discriminator for sharper outputs
  • Next Steps: Integrate CLIP for image ranking; adopt perceptual losses (LPIPS); scale model → combine with Stable Diffusion.

This project is architecturally and conceptually far more advanced than conventional Keras examples—it demands knowledge of sequence modeling, conv-deconv pipelines, multimodal data handling, and generative model fine-tuning.
